passage.label: Sad; oath by the Quran containing reminder; disbelievers in pride and dissension; prior generations destroyed crying out when escape had passed; wonder at a warner from among themselves called magician and liar; objection to making the gods one God; the eminent urging persistence over their gods and calling it a thing intended; claim of never hearing this in the latest religion and calling it fabrication; question whether the message was singled out for him; correction that they doubt the message and have not tasted the penalty; challenge on possessing the treasuries of mercy or the dominion of heavens and earth; defeated companies; Nuh, Aad, Pharaoh of the stakes, Thamud, the people of Lut and the companions of the thicket each denying so the penalty was justified; awaiting one blast with no delay; their demand to hasten their share before the Day of Account

arabicExcerpts.text: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي عِزَّةٖ وَشِقَاقٖ
كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن قَرۡنٖ فَنَادَواْ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٖ
وَعَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٞ مِّنۡهُمۡۖ وَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٞ كَذَّابٌ
أَجَعَلَ ٱلۡأٓلِهَةَ إِلَٰهٗا وَٰحِدًاۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عُجَابٞ
وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ مِنۡهُمۡ أَنِ ٱمۡشُواْ وَٱصۡبِرُواْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمۡۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٞ يُرَادُ
مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي ٱلۡمِلَّةِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخۡتِلَٰقٌ
أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ مِّن ذِكۡرِيۚ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِ
أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَحۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡوَهَّابِ
أَمۡ لَهُم مُّلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۖ فَلۡيَرۡتَقُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبِ
جُندٞ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهۡزُومٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ
كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَعَادٞ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ ذُو ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ
وَثَمُودُ وَقَوۡمُ لُوطٖ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ
إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٖ
وَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ

mainSubject.label: Oath by Sad and the dhikr-bearing Quran answered by pride and dissension; destroyed generations whose outcry came after the time of escape; rejection of a warner from among themselves as magician and liar; tawheed treated as a curious innovation and defended against by the elite in the name of ancestral religion; the singling-out objection answered by their doubt and untasted penalty; the treasury and dominion challenges exposing their lack of authority; a catalogue of denying communities whose penalty was justified; the single undelayed blast set against their impatient demand for punishment before the Day of Account

notes: Wave 6 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 ends at the punishment-hastening demand (16) before the patience command opens the Dawud block (17); P2 closes with the blessed-Book reflection verse (29); P3 groups the Sulayman, Ayyub and patriarch remembrance sequence (30-48); P4 is the two-returns contrast ending with the Fire quarrel (49-64); P5 begins with the warner-only declaration and runs through the Adam-Iblees narrative to the closing reminder (65-88).
